title: pterolepis pumila
intro: Pterolepis pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Heather or Alpine Heather, is a small, perennial plant that belongs to the family Ericaceae. The plant is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and anticancer properties. Research has also identified the presence of tannins, saponins, and essential oils in Pterolepis pumila, further solidifying its potential as a medicinal plant.
